_comment: Every entry is one insiliscope_cli run (options as in `insiliscope_cli --help`, without the leading --) rendered to a GIF. Adding a feature = adding an entry. 'group' orders the gallery page.
_overview: The 2x2 overview at the top of the gallery and on the Home page (tools/build_overview.py): one spot (x, y, um; tools/build_overview.py --suggest), its map, structures, widefield and SMLM movies.

entries.title: Default SMLM movie
entries.text: The default CellField: DNA-PAINT with an ATTO 655 imager (1.43 nM) on 70% of the microtubule binding sites, 640 nm excitation, the free imager's flat background, the Gibson-Lanni + Zernike PSF (MixedRealisticObjective aberrations), Kinetix22 sCMOS noise; 60 s after the illumination came on.

entries.title: Dense activation
entries.text: Imager concentration x10 (14.3 nM): ten times the binding rate, overlapping emitters and a ten times brighter free-imager background.

entries.title: dSTORM, AF647
entries.text: mt-dye AF647 (its dSTORM mode, 3% of the sites) with its light preset (dSTORM-640): blinks with Dempsey et al.'s photons per cycle and duty cycle, scaled to the laser intensity.

entries.title: dSTORM, the first seconds
entries.text: The same from t = 0 (start-sec 0): every dye starts ON and switches off over its initial ON time, so the movie starts as a widefield image and turns into blinks.

entries.title: PALM, mEos3.2
entries.text: mt-dye mEos3.2 (PALM, 25% of the sites) with its 561 nm preset (405 nm at 2 W/cm²): photoconverted proteins blink red until they bleach.

entries.title: PALM, mEos3.2 green state
entries.text: mEos3.2 imaged through the 488 nm path (WF-488 light preset) from t = 0: the unconverted green state shows as a widefield image, the red blinks barely pass the green filter.

entries.title: Multi-blink molecules
entries.text: AF647 with its dye field bleach-prob set to 0.3: each dye blinks ~3 times before it bleaches.

entries.title: Constant brightness
entries.text: The dye field photon-cv set to 0 (mt-dye.photon-cv): every blink equally bright (the library's is 0.5, a log-normal per-blink brightness spread with mean 1).

entries.title: DNA-PAINT without the imager background
entries.text: The default movie with the free-imager background left out (chamber-height-um 0): only the bound imagers. The background is the imager in the illuminated chamber; its depletion and its exclusion from cells are ignored.

entries.title: Background
entries.text: 50 background photons per pixel per second on top of the default movie.

entries.title: Sample drift (random walk)
entries.text: drift-xy-nm-per-sqrt-sec 200, drift-z-nm-per-sqrt-sec 100: a normal step per frame and axis, summed (RMS 200 nm per axis after 1 s; a stable setup drifts ~5-20). Exaggerated so it shows in 3 s; the cli also writes the true drift per frame (.drift.csv).

entries.title: Directed drift
entries.text: drift-xy-speed-nm-per-sec 150 in a seed-drawn direction, drift-z-speed-nm-per-sec 60, with 20 deg direction wander, 30% speed wander (correlation time 1 s here, 60 s by default) and a little random walk (20 nm/sqrt(s)). Exaggerated so it shows in 3 s.

entries.title: Focus 2 um above the coverslip
entries.text: Z stage at 2 um: dyes near the focal plane are sharp, those above and below it blur with the 3D PSF.

entries.title: Low NA (0.9)
entries.text: A wider PSF at NA 0.9 (diffraction limit about 0.61 lambda / NA).

entries.title: High NA (1.49)
entries.text: The same field at NA 1.49.

entries.title: Laser clean-up filter blocks a line
entries.text: dSTORM AF647 with 561 and 640 nm lasers on, through a 561 nm clean-up (Semrock FF01-561/14, ex-filter): the 640 nm line is blocked, only the weak 561 nm excitation of AF647 is left.

entries.title: Gaussian PSF (for comparison)
entries.text: psf-model Gaussian: sigma = 0.21 lambda / NA, no defocus, no aberrations. Fast, but every dye looks in focus.

entries.title: Astigmatism (3D SMLM)
entries.text: psf-zernike-preset AstigmatismModerate (0.15 waves of Zernike j = 5), focus 1 um up: spots stretch along x or y with their height.

entries.title: Double-helix PSF
entries.text: psf-mask DoubleHelix (Gauss-Laguerre phase mask, psf-mask-modes 5, psf-mask-waist 1, as webSMLM): most light goes into a ~2 um ring, the two z-rotating lobes inside it carry ~11%, so this uses bright (640 nm at 2.5 kW/cm^2), sparse (0.1 nM imager) emitters.

entries.title: Nearest-grid placement
entries.text: psf-interp Nearest: each emitter snaps to the 1/6 px kernel grid instead of the default cubic interpolation at its true position.

entries.title: Custom Zernike terms
entries.text: zern.12 = 0.3 waves of primary spherical aberration on top of the default preset, with a coarser kernel (psf-oversampling 4, psf-z-step-um 0.05, psf-z-range-um 7, psf-working-distance-um 150).

entries.title: Index mismatch (widefield)
entries.text: psf-sample-index 1.33 (water) with emitters 3 um deep (psf-sample-depth-nm 3000): Gibson-Lanni spherical aberration and focal shift; defocus blurs less in the lower-index sample.

entries.title: Noisy camera
entries.text: Read noise 6 e-, a flat QE of 0.5 (qe-curve Custom), 10% pixel-to-pixel gain spread.

entries.title: EMCCD camera
entries.text: camera-preset iXonUltra897: EMCCD gain register (excess noise), its noise values and QE curve, at 0.0066 e-/ADU (about 150 ADU per photoelectron, EM gain about 150) in single-molecule modes.

entries.title: Widefield, mEGFP
entries.text: mt-dye mEGFP (WideField mode, 70% of the sites) with its 488 nm preset: every dye emits at once, mean-field 3D PSF convolution over world-anchored z planes.

entries.title: Widefield, 2x grid upscaling
entries.text: Two dye-grid cells per pixel per axis (Renderer.WideFieldUpscaling = 2).

entries.title: Widefield photobleaching
entries.text: mEGFP with a 2000-photon budget (mt-dye.photon-budget) and 500 ms frames from t = 0: the image fades with the exact per-frame bleaching integral.

entries.title: Crosstalk: mEGFP in the 561 nm channel
entries.text: mEGFP imaged through the WF-561 light path: the residual 561 nm excitation and the red tail of its emission give a faint image (detected fraction and rate: Fluorophores.Microtubules_DetectedPct / PhotonsPerSecOn in MM).

entries.title: Widefield, focus 2 um up
entries.text: Focus moved up through the sample: the coverslip structures blur, upper cell features sharpen.

entries.title: Brightfield, focus 0.5 um
entries.text: Transmitted light through the cells' refractive index (cytoplasm, nucleus, microtubules only), partially coherent multislice optics at the default quality 3: near focus a phase object shows little contrast.

entries.title: Brightfield, focus 2 um below the coverslip
entries.text: z = -2: defocus turns the cells' phase into intensity; the nucleus dome acts as a weak lens and shows bright.

entries.title: Brightfield, nearly coherent
entries.text: bf-condenser-na 0.1: a closed condenser makes edges ring and raises contrast (fewer angles average out).

entries.title: Brightfield, plain ellipsoid nuclei
entries.text: p.nucIrregMin/Max 0, p.nucBendMax 0, p.nucThickIrreg 0, p.nucAsym 0, p.nucWidestMin/Max 0.5: the nucleus shape switched off (lobes, kidney bend, uneven thickness, wider base), for comparison with the default.

entries.title: Brightfield, quality 1 (fastest)
entries.text: bf-quality 1: one thin phase screen, 6 condenser points, camera-pixel grid; compare with the default (quality 3).

entries.title: Lasers and lamp both on
entries.text: light-epi 1 and light-trans 1: the DNA-PAINT fluorescence and a dimmed lamp (5000 photons/px/s) on one camera, the lamp's photons times the QE added before one noise chain.

entries.title: Cell packing off
entries.text: Packing disabled: cells may overlap (the packing step is what makes the layout chaotic and seed-exact).

entries.title: Higher occupancy, denser microtubules
entries.text: Occupancy 0.5, microtubule density 1.6 per um^2.
